name: UnpivotNode
label: Unpivot
description: Melts a wide data table into a long format. Designated value columns are turned into two columns: one holding the column name and one holding the value, with the remaining columns kept per row.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The wide data table to unpivot.

fields.name: ColumnsToUnpivot
fields.label: Columns To Unpivot
fields.description: Comma-separated column names to melt into name/value pairs. Leave empty to unpivot all columns.

fields.name: NameColumn
fields.label: Name Column
fields.description: The name of the column that will hold the original column names. Defaults to 'Column'.

fields.name: ValueColumn
fields.label: Value Column
fields.description: The name of the column that will hold the cell values. Defaults to 'Value'.
